meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 不再走 OneCLI 网关,而是直接从项目 .env 文件读取 Anthropic 的 API 密钥或 OAuth 令牌,把它作为环境变量注入容器,供 API 请求使用。
howto.when: 当 .env 中设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 并重启 NanoClaw 服务后生效;未设置时功能和原来一样。

say.text: 请检查 .env 里的 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 是否有效
say.note: 会从 .env 读取并尝试连接

say.text: 确认当前用的是 .env 凭证吗?
重启服务让 .env 凭证生效

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude stops using the OneCLI gateway and instead reads the Anthropic API key or OAuth token directly from the project's .env file, injecting it into the container's environment for API requests.
howto.when_en: Active when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env and the NanoClaw service is restarted; otherwise nothing changes.

say_en.text: Check if the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env is valid
say_en.note: Reads from .env and tries to connect

say_en.text: Are you using the .env credential now?
Restart service to apply the .env credential
